name: Olga Kuznetsova
institution: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
thesis: Magnetically actuated soft microrobots for targeted drug delivery
transitionSignals: Filed first patent on a microrobot design
description: Olga builds millimeter-scale soft robots that navigate fluidic environments under magnetic control for localized therapy. Her materials and biocompatibility work positions her for a medical-robotics R&D role.
